pages.text: Follow the skid marks to the carrier. Use the decoder on the lock in normal mode. Leave an escape lane by the barrier. If your field notes report a blocked exit, clear the space behind it and restore the floor. The encounter needs a non-Peaceful difficulty.

Bait Goliath into charging the barrier, sidestep and strike the exposed right knee. Follow the weak-point openings, or wear it down with sustained damage. Save the heavy armor core for the pump.$(br2)$(l:hive)Next: the colossal hive$(/l)
